section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of body appreciation using the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), a 10-item single-factor instrument with a 5-point Likert scale. The scale demonstrated good internal consistency (Cronbach's α = 0.89) and adequate model fit according to confirmatory factor analysis (RMSEA = 0.078, CFI = 0.967, TLI = 0.937, SRMR = 0.030). No specific study designation is mentioned in this methods subsection.
